comics.title: Great men of history
transcript: I will be one of the great men of history! My life will define an era!!
Son do you want some cookies?
I'll have it all figured out by the time I'm 35
comics.observations: Three panels: grand ambition, a parent offering cookies while he plays a computer game, then a deferred deadline. Commentary is not an additional published panel.

comics.title: The brain parasite
transcript: Are you eating dirt & grubs off the ground?
My brain parasite says you're toxic
comics.observations: A character eats from the ground; another warns him. The reply attributes the dismissal to his brain parasite. Do not invent a fourth panel or medical advice.

comics.title: White to white
transcript: Beautiful! I love a job well done
You painted all the walls from white to white?
No, it used to be egg-shell. Now it's ivory
You have too much free time on your hands
comics.observations: A painter praises the completed work. The other character questions repainting white walls; the painter distinguishes eggshell from ivory.
